T1.title: Say hello
T1.instruction: Make Teddy walk to the tree. Then make him say "Hello".
T1.hint: Teddy can walk to things. After that, he can say something.
T2.title: Together
T2.instruction: Make Polybot move to the fence. At the same time, make Teddy turn to watch Polybot.
T2.hint: Do together runs the blocks inside it at the same time.
T3.title: Three jumps
T3.instruction: Make Dino kid jump three times.
T3.hint: A jump is a move up, then a move down. A count can do it more than once.
T4.title: Click me
T4.instruction: When someone clicks Autumn the dog, make her say "Woof".
T4.hint: An event starts blocks when something happens, like a click.
T5.title: Fix it
T5.instruction: Red Riding Hood turns the wrong way. Fix it, so she ends facing Grandmother.
T5.hint: Rehearse it and watch which way she turns. Then change that block.
